MCP Server Pydantic
MCP Server Pydantic is a deep specialist that manages domain expertise and code generation in the 3-Layer Agent Architecture.

Claude Code
Claude Code serves as the Master Orchestrator in the 3-Layer Agent Architecture, focusing on high-level coordination, context management, and decision-making.

Workflow A
Workflow A is a quick and efficient process that is executed in parallel within the evolutionary workflow system.

Workflow Router
Workflow Router is responsible for directing user requests to the appropriate workflows based on predictions made by the OpenEvolve Predictor.

Subagent Claude
Subagent Claude functions as a domain expert utilizing the Claude API for planning, architecture, and generating responses.

EVO
EVO is an advanced system for AI agent orchestration that learns and optimizes autonomously using evolutionary algorithms to determine optimal combinations of agents, tools, and workflows for specific tasks.

Workflow C
Workflow C is considered research-heavy and is executed in parallel with other workflows in the system.

OpenEvolve Integration
OpenEvolve Integration is a process that predicts workflows and evaluates them to determine optimal combinations for user requests.

Workflow B
Workflow B offers a thorough and validated approach to task execution within the evolutionary workflow system.

User Request
User Request initiates the workflow routing process in the evolutionary workflow system.

3-Layer Agent Architecture
The 3-Layer Agent Architecture is a framework that organizes the coordination, planning, and execution of tasks using different types of agents in the EVO system.

Parallel Execution
Workflow A is executed in parallel for enhanced efficiency.

CLAUDE CODE
CLAUDE CODE interacts with MCP Server Pydantic to delegate tasks based on domain expertise.

OpenEvolve Predictor
The Workflow Router collaborates with the OpenEvolve Predictor to determine the best workflows for execution.

RAG-Anything
RAG-Anything is an advanced system for processing multimodal documents using deep learning algorithms.

PDF
PDF is a complex document format that can be analyzed by the RAG-Anything system.

Deep Learning Algorithms
Deep learning algorithms are utilized by the system to process texts, images, tables, and mathematical formulas.

Office Documents
Office documents are another format that the RAG-Anything system can process effectively.

Multimodal Documents
Multimodal documents refer to documents that contain multiple types of data, including text, images, tables, and formulas.
